articles.title: A Tiny Red Dot From the Baby Universe Might Be a Baby Black Hole
articles.summary: The James Webb telescope has spotted CW-LRD-z10, a tiny red object from when the universe was just 450 million years old that may be the earliest known baby black hole — though scientists say it is only a candidate for now.

articles.title: Old Plastic Pipes Could Become Engine Oil
articles.summary: Virginia Tech researchers found a way to turn hard-to-recycle PVC plastic into a high-performance lubricant ingredient.

articles.title: Screen Time May Matter Most at Ages 1 and 6, Scientists Find
articles.summary: A study of 502 children in Singapore found extra screen time at ages 1 and 6 was linked to weaker school results and working memory later — a link, not proof of cause, but a reason researchers say less screen time is better.
